title: Silk and Venom
description: Guildmaster Vorn has another contract for you. The old mine north of Millbrook has been abandoned for weeks - foreman Kettil Marsh pulled his whole crew out after losing two men to something in the lower galleries, and the mine's owners are paying the Guild to get their ore moving again before the men take work elsewhere for good. The spiders have made the mine their nest, and their webs now choke the upper tunnels. Clear out the infestation, kill the spider queen, and collect venom sacs for the alchemists - Kettil won't send his crew back down until someone shows him the queen's corpse.

objectives.description: Reach the mine Kettil Marsh's crew won't go back into
Kill the spiders that drove the miners out
Collect venom sacs for the alchemists' fee
Kill the spider queen - Kettil wants to see the body
Tell Vorn the mine is safe for Kettil's crew

notes: Spider infestation dungeon near Millbrook. Boss fight against spider queen. Venom sacs are valuable alchemy materials. Rewards include special spider silk rope item useful for climbing/exploration. Threat: a mine idled after two miners died, its foreman (Kettil Marsh) and crew refusing to go back. Giver motive: the mine's owners are paying to get ore moving before the crew scatters for good. Consequence: the crew leaves for other work if the mine stays shut - stated in prose, not wired.
